sources.title: Map of Saskatchewan Showing Completed Watershed Plans
sources.publication_date_note: The printed production date is November 25, 2014. The 2025/05 URL folder does not change the map date.
sources.inspection_scope: Historical full-feature review of the map and the complete selected source and baseline outlines. It supports regional correspondence, without an exact shoreline or name-boundary partition.
sources.source_limit: The regional thematic map cautions that accuracy, completeness and currency depend on available data and intended use.

independence_note: These findings rely on one official cartographic publication. Separate regions or copies are not independent sources.
included_evidence_limit: The included files retain factual observations, bibliographic references and selected public-domain lake geometry. The original publications and inspection materials are not included. Offline validation checks the included records and geometry; it does not reopen those publications or reproduce visual map judgments.
